candidates.tagline: Nokia's 'dumbphone' has a giant AI button. Need a smartphone to pay for it.
candidates.story: HMD launched four new Nokia feature phones — explicitly marketed to people who want to escape smartphones and AI — each with a prominent dedicated AI button in the centre that, after a 180-day free trial, requires a separate smartphone app to renew the subscription.
candidates.why_funny: The entire value proposition of a dumb phone is that you don't need a smartphone; Nokia built one that literally requires you to own a smartphone just to keep its AI button working.
candidates.alt: Nokia 210 4G feature phone with a large dedicated AI button prominently displayed on the front keypad panel

candidates.tagline: OpenAI's browser was going to rethink the web. It didn't last 9 months.
candidates.story: OpenAI launched the Atlas browser in October 2025 promising to 'rethink the web itself' with AI at the core — and is shutting it down August 9, 2026, less than 9 months later, after executives decided it was a 'side quest' and folded its features into a Chrome extension instead.
candidates.why_funny: They announced they were going to reinvent how all of humanity browses the internet, then quietly concluded the browser was basically a distraction and shipped a Chrome extension.
candidates.alt: Screenshot of the ChatGPT Atlas browser interface, showing an AI-powered browser window with a ChatGPT sidebar alongside a standard web page
